AUDIO_QUALITY_DOC: Quality for episodes and live streams (live: high 320, normal 128, low 32 kbit/s AAC)
PAGE_SIZE_DOC: How many episodes to show at a time (1–200)
DETECT_SERIES_DOC: Show the program's series at the top, with parts in order so the next part plays automatically. Needs a few extra requests the first time a program is opened.
CONTINUE_SERIES_DOC: When an episode of a numbered series plays, however you found it, the following parts are queued right after it.
NO_FAVORITES: No favourites yet. Use ♥ or "Add to favourites" in the menu of a channel, program, series or episode.
